Rereading homestuck (Part 1 of ???)

(SPOILERS FOR HOMESTUCK, OBVIOUSLY)

Homestuck is a webcomic by a guy I hate named Andrew Hussie about 4 kids who play a video game that destroys the world. It launched about a month before I was born, and has gained a massive cult following since then.

(Credit to Hookahfinch for the image)

My first impression of homestuck was in this video on youtube:

The second time was during 5th grade when I saw some high schooler drawing Vriska (one of the trolls) in the lobby.

After that, I didn't pay much mind to whatever Homestuck was. I knew it was a comic, but i didnt have the time to read 8000 pages.

Maybe I would see a few things on twitter about it, but I didn't really gaf. After all, I was an object show kid, I HAD to stay loyal to my clan or the consequences would be dire...

Fastforward to 2022, this video shows up on my feed.

It was a video of an fnf mod by bbpanzu, based on page 2852 of the webcomic. And GOD It was lowkey catchy.

I hate to say this, but this is what got me into Homestuck.

It took me 3 days and 3 nights to finish it, I was hooked.

I was a homestuck now!

Since then I have made fanart, made my own fankids and fantrolls, read fan-ventures from MSPFA, and have even made my own!

But if you asked me anything about the comic, the alchemy, the dancestors, or the classpecting, I would have a hard time answering.

Because the truth is, I didn't actually read the comic. I skimmed through the pesterlogs, skipped reading the descriptions, and I even skipped a big important flash! I wasnt a fan, I was a LARPER (sobs)!!!!

But that changes today! (or about 3 days ago)

3 days ago, I had began to read Homestuck in my downtime, and REALLY read it this time! I was gonna read ALL THE PESTERLOGS and ALL OF THE FLASHES and go through ALL OF THE SYLLADEXES AND CAPTCHALOGS AND ALL OF THE SUCH.

I am currently on ACT 5, page 2085, here are my many thoughts:

Misc. thoughts

  • My favorite parts so far are all the alchemy montages, it's just so fun to watch the kids make complete bullshit.

  • My favorite joke was when Terezi slaps Karkat, then later John tells past Terezi about the whole ordeal, which causes her to slap Karkat in the first place

  • Man sometimes it can be easy to get lost or confused when youre reading this, at times, I'll wonder how this character ended up like this, or how this character got this item, but I usually go back to reread anything i missed.

  • I love how everything connects in this comic. I dont know whether Hussie had a whole plan about this, but whether or not he does, he is very good at connecting things that may seem meaningless at first. Is that what foreshadowing is?

  • The dynamics with the trolls so far is also something to write home about! They really seem to hate each other on the surface, but they also genuinely care for each other! I especially liked the conversation with Karkat and Terezi

  • I really wish there were comments on the homestuck website cause I wonder how people reacted to seeing the designs for the trolls, and i wonder how people discussed the pages when they were coming out. I hope I can find some threads on some archives of the mspa forums.

My top characters so far

I saw this on a reddit post about someone else doing this so maybe ill do it too.

Keep in mind that these are my TOP characters, so i dont necessarily hate any of them.

  1. John
  2. Dave
  3. Jade
  4. Sollux
  5. Terezi
  6. Karkat
  7. Dad
  8. Rose

Closing thoughts

I hope I enjoy seeing of the trolls in the futue pages! Im also looking forward to seeing more of the session of our 4 kids. When I'm done, I also want to check out the epilogues and Beyond Canon, I heard they are very, VERY, conterversial.

After im done with this blog post im gonna go do some homework and maybe read some more panels of this stuff! Make sure to sign my guestbook before you leave! Toodles!
